variants.exact: HF transformers 5.16.1 Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration (models/glm5next/reference.py) in F32 on the GPU runner (tools/refrun) over the NVIDIA NVFP4 export, dense MLPs' and routed experts' E2M1 codes times their E4M3 group scales and F32 global scale rounded once to F32 (dequant rounded): the gate variant
variants.bf16: HF transformers 5.16.1 Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration (models/glm5next/reference.py) in BF16 over the NVIDIA NVFP4 export, weights dequantized and rounded to BF16 as HF loads them (dequant hf-bf16), F32 log-softmax: spread variant

provenance.positions: entry i scores the token at score_from + i from the logits of the row before it; top1 is the highest logit (ties to the lower ID), margin its logit minus the second's, and the top-k columns are ranked by logit
